coverage: Read every captured post for all twelve selected topics, including final replies, corrections, and retractions. Retain every topic in the screening denominator.

decisions.replay_candidate: A reported input condition has a stated intent, bounded test, explicit source-backed correction, recoverable original input and relevant dependencies. This authorizes preparation, not a validity label.
decisions.needs_evidence: An input report may support a bounded condition but lacks a correction, recoverable input, relevant dependency, or sufficiently specified intent. Record the gap and a specific next action.
decisions.excluded: The discussion concerns engine behavior, compilation/environment, an announcement, a feature request, or a usage question without a reported incorrect input. Preserve its evidence and reason; exclusion does not assert input validity.

evidence: Record complete post-number coverage, cited post numbers with short exact text anchors, artifact receipts, intent, condition, proposed correction, dependency gaps, rationale, and next action. Examine captured text artifacts only as data; do not execute or unpack attachments.
review: Codex model-assisted development screening. No independent human adjudication or proof of reviewer identity. The validator checks evidence integrity and form consistency, not the truth of interpretations or that reading occurred.
exposure: Titles and structural counts were visible during discovery. Criteria are fixed before complete-thread screening. These are development sources; no blinded or held-out evaluation is claimed.
bounds: No native simulations, checker observations, or agent trials. No automatic gold admission. Original discovery metadata, pending form, and historical archives remain unchanged.
